labels: The shoulders turn toward a classroom door while the head rotates back toward the desk, with both eyes directed at the notebook there.; 어깨는 교실 문으로 향하고 머리는 책상 쪽으로 돌아가며 두 눈이 그곳의 공책을 향한다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The shoulders turn toward a classroom door while the head rotates back toward the desk, with both eyes directed at the notebook there.
aliases: 상체 회전과 시선의 분리
